function.description: This function is used to create a recommendation model using a given user data and an algorithm type Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_data.description: A data frame of user ratings. Rows represent users, columns represent items, and entries represent user ratings for items

algorithm.description: The algorithm to be used for creating the recommendation model. Collaborative filtering, content-based filtering and hybrid filtering.

matrix_factorization.description: Optional parameter to indicate whether matrix factorization should be used. Default is False.

message.content:
Below is a **step‑by‑step playbook** you can follow to turn your e‑commerce idea into a polished, production‑ready frontend. I’ll cover the whole pipeline – from design to deployment – and give you concrete code snippets, folder layouts, and tooling recommendations. Feel free to skip sections that already match your stack. --- ## 1. Planning & Design | What to do | Why it matters | |------------|----------------| | **Define core pages** – Home, Category, Product Detail, Cart, Checkout, Account, Admin | Keeps scope focused | | **Sketch wireframes** – use Figma/Sketch/Adobe XD | Visualise layout early | | **Create a design system** – colors, typography, spacing, reusable components | Consistency & speed | | **Plan user flows** – add to cart → checkout → payment → confirmation | Guides component hierarchy | > **Tip:** Export design tokens (JSON) from Figma and import them into your CSS/JS (e.g., `@use` in SCSS or `styled-components` theme). --- ## 2. Choose a Tech Stack | Option | When to pick it | Key libraries | |--------|-----------------|---------------| | **React + Vite** | Fast dev server, modern build | React, Vite, React Router, Zustand/Redux Toolkit | | **Next.js** | Server‑side rendering (SEO), API routes | Next.js, SWR/React‑Query, Tailwind | | **Vue + Vite** | Simpler learning curve, reactivity | Vue 3, Vite, Pinia, Vue Router | | **SvelteKit** | Small bundle, built‑in SSR | SvelteKit, Svelte Query | | **TypeScript** | Strong typing, maintainability | ✅ | > **Recommendation:** For most e‑commerce sites, **Next.js + Tailwind + React Query** gives you SEO, fast builds, and a great developer experience. --- ## 3. Project Setup ```bash # Example: Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind npx create-next-app@latest my-store --ts cd my-store npm install tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer npx tailwindcss init -p ``` **`tailwind.config.js`** ```js module.exports = { content: ['./pages/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}', './components/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}'], theme: { extend: {} }, plugins: [], } ``` **`globals.css`** ```css @tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities; ``` **Folder structure** ``` my-store/ ├─ components/ │ ├─ ui/ # Button, Card, Modal, etc. │ ├─ layout/ # Header, Footer, Sidebar │ └─ pages/ # Page‑specific components ├─ hooks/ ├─ lib/ │ ├─ api.ts # API wrapper │ └─ auth.ts ├─ pages/ │ ├─ index.tsx │ ├─ product/[id].tsx │ ├─ cart.tsx │ └─ checkout.tsx ├─ public/ ├─ styles/ │ └─ globals.css ├─ .env.local ├─ next.config.js └─ package.json ``` --- ## 4. Component Architecture ### 4.1 UI Library (Tailwind + Headless UI) ```tsx // components/ui/Button.tsx import { FC } from 'react'; export const Button: FC> = ({ children, className, ...props }) => ( ); ``` ### 4.2 Page‑Specific Components ```tsx // components/pages/ProductCard.tsx import Image from 'next/image'; import Link from 'next/link'; import { Button } from '../ui/Button'; export const ProductCard = ({ product }) => (

{product.title}

${product.price}

); ``` --- ## 5. State Management | Library | Use‑case | |---------|----------| | **React Query** | Data fetching, caching, optimistic updates | | **Zustand** | Simple global store (cart, auth) | | **Redux Toolkit** | Complex state, devtools, persistence | **Example: Cart Store (Zustand)** ```ts // hooks/useCart.ts import create from 'zustand'; interface CartItem { id: string; quantity: number; } interface CartState { items: CartItem[]; add: (item: CartItem) => void; remove: (id: string) => void; } export const useCart = create((set) => ({ items: [], add: (item) => set((state) => ({ items: [...state.items, item] })), remove: (id) => set((state) => ({ items: state.items.filter(i => i.id !== id) })), })); ``` --- ## 6. API Integration ### 6.1 REST Wrapper ```ts // lib/api.ts import axios from 'axios'; const api = axios.create({ baseURL: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, }); export const fetchProducts = () => api.get('/products').then(r => r.data); export const fetchProduct = (id: string) => api.get(`/products/${id}`).then(r => r.data); ``` ### 6.2 Using React Query ```tsx // pages/index.tsx import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'; import { fetchProducts } from '../lib/api'; import { ProductCard } from '../components/pages/ProductCard'; export default function Home() { const { data, isLoading, error } = useQuery(['products'], fetchProducts); if (isLoading) return

Loading…

; if (error) return

Something went wrong.

; return (
{data.map((p) => ( ))}
); } ``` --- ## 7. Styling & Theming | Tool | What it does | |------|--------------| | **Tailwind CSS** | Utility‑first styling | | **Headless UI** | Accessible UI primitives | | **CSS Modules / SCSS** | Scoped styles for complex components | | **styled‑components** | CSS‑in‑JS with theming support | > **Tip:** Keep Tailwind for layout & spacing; use CSS Modules for component‑specific overrides. --- ## 8. Routing & Navigation - **Next.js** – file‑based routing (`pages/`). - **React Router** – if you’re on plain React. - **Dynamic routes** – e.g., `/product/[id].tsx`. **Persist cart across pages** – store in localStorage or use `zustand-persist`. --- ## 9. Performance & SEO | Technique | How | |-----------|-----| | **Image Optimization** | `next/image` or `imgix` | | **Code Splitting** | Dynamic imports (`next/dynamic`) | | **Lazy Loading** | `loading="lazy"` on images | | **SSR / SSG** | Next.js `getStaticProps` / `getServerSideProps` | | **Incremental Static Regeneration** | `revalidate` in `getStaticProps` | | **Critical CSS** | Tailwind purge + `@apply` | | **Bundle Analysis** | `next-bundle-analyzer` | --- ## 10. Testing | Layer | Tool | |-------|------| | **Unit** | Jest + React Testing Library | | **E2E** | Cypress or Playwright | | **Component** | Storybook (visual regression) | **Example Jest test** ```tsx // __tests__/ProductCard.test.tsx import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'; import { ProductCard } from '../components/pages/ProductCard'; test('renders product title', () => { const product = { id: '1', title: 'Test', price: 9.99, image: '/img.png' }; render(); expect(screen.getByText('Test')).toBeInTheDocument(); }); ``` --- ## 11. Deployment & CI/CD | Platform | What it offers | |----------|----------------| | **Vercel** | Zero‑config Next.js, preview URLs | | **Netlify** | Build hooks, functions | | **Render** | Docker, cron jobs | | **AWS Amplify** | Hosting + backend | | **Docker + Kubernetes** | Full control | **GitHub Actions example** ```yaml # .github/workflows/deploy.yml name: Deploy on: push: branches: [main] jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: '20' - run: npm ci - run: npm run build - uses: vercel/action@v1 with: vercel-token: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }} vercel-org-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }} vercel-project-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID }} ``` --- ## 12. Security & Accessibility | Concern | Mitigation | |---------|------------| | **XSS** | Escape all user input, use `next/image` for images | | **CSRF** | Same‑site cookies, CSRF tokens | | **CORS** | Configure backend to allow only your domain | | **HTTPS** | Enforce via HSTS | | **Accessibility** | Semantic HTML, ARIA roles, `@headlessui/react` components | | **Performance** | Lighthouse audit, critical path CSS, image compression | --- ## 13. Sample `.env.local` ```dotenv NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.myshop.com NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=pk_test_12345 ``` --- ## 14. Quick Checklist 1. **Design** → Export tokens → Build UI library 2. **Setup** → Install Next.js + Tailwind + TypeScript 3. **Build** → Create pages, components, hooks 4. **State** → Cart + Auth store 5. **API** → Axios wrapper + React Query 6. **Test** → Unit + E2E + Storybook 7. **Optimize** → Image, code split, SSR/SSG 8. **Deploy** → Vercel + GitHub Actions 9. **Monitor** → Sentry, LogRocket, analytics --- ### Final Thought Start small: build a **single product page** with a working “Add to Cart” button. Once that works, scaffold the rest of the pages. Keep the code modular, test often, and iterate on the design. Happy coding! 🚀
